tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Paper. The page ground on every surface. Ink text on it holds 16.7:1 (light) and 16:1 (dark).

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Ink. Body text, headings and the core tile on background, card, muted and every part tint.

tokens.name: foreground-soft
tokens.usage: Soft ink. Running text: paragraphs and ledes. Headings, the item being shown and words that point at the board stay ink. 8.1:1 on background (light), 11.5:1 (dark).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised sheets that sit on paper: plates, dialogs, plugin and surface tiles, inputs.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, tooltips and other floating layers. Pair with shadow-pop.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The action colour: filled buttons, the current tab rule, selected rows. Renoa has no hue accent; ink is the accent.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill and pressed states.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: code blocks, table headers, skeletons, the needs-you wash behind a row.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Supporting copy, captions, eyebrows and inactive navigation. 5.9:1 on background, 5.5:1 on muted (light); 7.2:1 and 6.1:1 (dark).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and highlighted-row wash for rows, menu items and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: row dividers, section rules, plate edges. Decorative only; never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects, switches and outline buttons. 3.2:1 on background and 3.5:1 on card (light); 3.3:1 and 3.1:1 (dark).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Control Center navigation rail ground.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Current destination marker in the rail.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on sidebar-primary.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Hovered and current rail item wash.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on sidebar-accent.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Rail edge and dividers.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring inside the rail.

tokens.name: part-model
tokens.usage: The model: the language model that does the thinking. Marks only (tile edges, part-chip hexes, chart series), never text. 3:1 or better on background and card in both themes.

tokens.name: part-model-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of the model tile and the hovered model row. Ink text on it holds 15:1 (light) and 10:1 (dark).

tokens.name: part-loop
tokens.usage: Workflow (id loop): how an agent works through a task, step by step. Marks only (tile edges, part-chip hexes, chart series), never text. 3:1 or better on background and card in both themes.

tokens.name: part-loop-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of the loop tile and the hovered loop row. Ink text on it holds 15:1 (light) and 10:1 (dark).

tokens.name: part-context
tokens.usage: Context: what an agent keeps in mind as a conversation gets longer. Marks only (tile edges, part-chip hexes, chart series), never text. 3:1 or better on background and card in both themes.

tokens.name: part-context-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of the context tile and the hovered context row. Ink text on it holds 15:1 (light) and 10:1 (dark).

tokens.name: part-tools
tokens.usage: Tools: actions an agent can take. Plugins add to it, so plugin tiles wear this edge. Marks only (tile edges, part-chip hexes, chart series), never text. 3:1 or better on background and card in both themes.

tokens.name: part-tools-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of the tools tile and the hovered tools row. Ink text on it holds 15:1 (light) and 10:1 (dark).

tokens.name: part-skills
tokens.usage: Skills: know-how for particular kinds of jobs. Marks only (tile edges, part-chip hexes, chart series), never text. 3:1 or better on background and card in both themes.

tokens.name: part-skills-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of the skills tile and the hovered skills row. Ink text on it holds 15:1 (light) and 10:1 (dark).

tokens.name: part-profile
tokens.usage: Profile: who the agent is, and what it has learned about the owner. Marks only (tile edges, part-chip hexes, chart series), never text. 3:1 or better on background and card in both themes.

tokens.name: part-profile-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of the profile tile and the hovered profile row. Ink text on it holds 15:1 (light) and 10:1 (dark).

tokens.name: state-needs-you
tokens.usage: An agent waiting on the owner: the one state the owner can act on, so it wears the action colour. Filled dot and the words Needs you.

tokens.name: state-needs-you-wash
tokens.usage: Row wash behind something that needs the owner.

tokens.name: state-running
tokens.usage: Work in progress, assigned work and event triggers. Text and dot; 4.9:1 on background (light), 8.6:1 (dark).

tokens.name: state-failed
tokens.usage: Work that actually broke. Text, dot and the destructive action. 5.7:1 on background (light), 7.5:1 (dark).

tokens.name: state-failed-wash
tokens.usage: Row wash behind a failure. state-failed text holds 5.3:1 on it in both themes.

tokens.name: state-idle
tokens.usage: Nothing pending. Hollow dot and the word Idle.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: shadcn destructive: delete and remove actions, error text.

tokens.name: board-line
tokens.usage: Empty sockets on the board: the faint hex lattice behind tiles that says there is room to extend.

tokens.name: trace
tokens.usage: RCP traces: connections drawn along the seams between tiles, and the packets that travel them.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1. Series colours reuse part pigments, so keep a legend with words.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2. Series colours reuse part pigments, so keep a legend with words.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3. Series colours reuse part pigments, so keep a legend with words.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4. Series colours reuse part pigments, so keep a legend with words.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5. Series colours reuse part pigments, so keep a legend with words.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: type-display
styles.sample: Your agents share one library and talk over one line.
styles.usage: Landing hero only, one per page. Pair with the rn-condensed class (wdth 86).

styles.name: type-headline
styles.sample: Add it once. Every agent can use it.

styles.name: type-title
styles.usage: Control Center page titles: an agent's name, Work, Connections.

styles.name: type-heading
styles.usage: Section and panel headings inside a page.

styles.name: type-lede
styles.sample: Renoa is an open-source system for running AI agents on your own server.
styles.usage: Opening paragraph under a display or title. Max 34em.

styles.name: type-body
styles.sample: Swap in a newer model. The core and the other parts carry on as before.

styles.name: type-label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, field labels, row titles.

styles.name: type-tile
styles.usage: The name inside a hex tile.

styles.name: type-eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows, kickers, figure captions, tile metadata. Always uppercase.

styles.name: type-code
styles.usage: Stored identifiers, versions, digests, preset names. Never headings or navigation.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a button's icon and label; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; row inner padding (block).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum page gutter; field stacks; plate padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Plate padding; gap between form sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between a page title and its first section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Landing section rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Part-chip corners, code spans, the switch knob.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, small buttons, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, the switch track. shadcn --radius.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Plates, dialogs, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: State badges and dots only. A circle means live state; nothing else is round.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: menus, popovers, a tile lifted mid-swap. Everything else is flat.

tile.note: Geometry of the hex board. Tiles are flat-top hexagons on axial coordinates.

tokens.name: tile-radius
tokens.usage: Circumradius of a full-size tile on the landing board. Rosettes scale it down.

tokens.name: tile-grout
tokens.usage: Gap between neighbouring tiles. RCP traces run inside it.

tokens.name: tile-corner
tokens.usage: Corner rounding of a tile at full size.

tokens.name: tile-stroke
tokens.usage: Tile edge width, drawn with vector-effect non-scaling-stroke.

tokens.name: tile-depth
tokens.usage: Height of the body under a tile's face at full size. A seated tile shows it as a band along its lower edges, so the board reads as pieces, not outlines.

tokens.name: tile-lift
tokens.usage: How far a face rises for one unit of lift. A tile lifts while it is swapped, carried to another agent or waiting for approval, and its shadow shows on the socket below.
